tools.name: devmap_status
tools.description: Index health for this repository: generation id, node and edge counts, how many files are pending, any degraded reason, and the build-time resolution_rate (per-language attribution coverage).

tools.name: devmap_search
tools.description: Find symbols by name across the indexed repository. Returns ranked hits with file and line, budgeted to a token cap.

tools.name: devmap_ask
tools.description: Plain-language find over the call graph. Seeds with TF-IDF over symbol names plus docstrings when present, then re-ranks with personalized PageRank over stored call edges.

tools.name: devmap_ask_evidence
tools.description: The devmap_ask answer shaped for reading, so the first reads are already done. Three quarters of budget go to the hits, in devmap_ask's order; a hit whose lines an earlier hit already prints costs only its lead, so the pack holds every hit devmap_ask would at that budget and sometimes more.

tools.name: devmap_dependencies
tools.description: What the target depends on — its outbound edges. Accepts a file path or a symbol name.

tools.name: devmap_impact
tools.description: Blast radius: what reaches the target, walked in reverse to a depth cap. Use before deleting or changing a symbol.

tools.name: devmap_trace
tools.description: Forward call paths from a symbol, or the paths between two symbols when 'to' is supplied.

tools.name: devmap_neighbors
tools.description: Callers and callees for up to 16 targets in one exchange. Prefer this over separate dependencies+impact calls: it is one round trip and it detects when the index moved underneath the answer.

tools.name: devmap_dead_symbols
tools.description: Dead-symbol candidates with per-row confidence — not one flat delete list. High confidence (above the degraded ceiling) means no inbound evidence after the call walk; only_ambiguous_callers and unresolved-namesake rows sit at 0.4 (unconfirmed).

tools.name: devmap_skeleton
tools.description: Definitions in one file as signature plus span — never the body. When a signature was not extracted the span is still returned and the row says so.

tools.name: devmap_clones
tools.description: Duplicate and structurally similar code groups.

tools.name: devmap_preview
tools.description: Speculative edit preview: given replacement content for a file, report which callers the edit would break before it is written. Reads the index and the supplied content; writes nothing.

tools.name: devmap_explore
tools.description: Definitions matching a query, each with its source, its callers, its callees and a layered blast radius — the whole neighbourhood in one call.

tools.name: devmap_affected_tests
tools.description: Test files reachable through the inbound blast radius of some symbols — which tests to run for a change. Ranked nearest-first, so a budget-trimmed list keeps the tests closest to the change.

tools.name: devmap_suspects
tools.description: Which commits since a known-good revision could have caused a symptom.

tools.name: devmap_blast
tools.description: What a change affects: the symbols, files, modules and test files downstream of the lines it touched. The mirror of devmap_suspects — this walks **inbound** call edges, because a change breaks what calls it, never what it calls.

tools.name: gitpulse_insights
tools.description: One-shot snapshot of worktrees, agent sessions, uncommitted changes, overlapping dirty files, ledger, and code-graph availability. Facets fail independently so a missed scan never looks clean.

tools.name: gitpulse_status
tools.description: Inspect repository status, worktrees, ledger, and code graph availability

tools.name: gitpulse_active_changes
tools.description: Working-tree file list for a worktree (path, staged, conflicted, churn), capped. A failed read is reported rather than an empty list.

tools.name: gitpulse_collision_risk
tools.description: Files with uncommitted changes in more than one worktree — parallel agent checkouts editing the same path. Unscanned worktrees are counted, never implied clean.

tools.name: gitpulse_change_context
tools.description: In-flight context for one worktree: branch, dirty files, parked merge/rebase, bound task, and collisions that involve it.

tools.name: gitpulse_ledger_events
tools.description: Read durable ledger event history (actor, tool, verdict, changes), oldest first from cursor. Page by passing the last id you saw back as cursor; truncated says whether more follow.

tools.name: gitpulse_task_view
tools.description: Read task leases plus evidence, gaps, and verification runs from dc-store. Never acquires a lease.

tools.name: gitpulse_add_task
tools.description: File a task on the GitPulse task board for this repository — the board a person sees and launches agents from. Prefer fewer, larger tasks: before filing, call gitpulse_list_tasks and fold related work into one task (one coherent concern each) rather than one task per finding.

tools.name: gitpulse_import_tasks
tools.description: Put the Markdown task briefs in the repository's tasks folder onto the GitPulse task board. Requires the repository to be trusted.

tools.name: gitpulse_list_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks on the GitPulse task board for this repository, in board order. repository null means no task has ever been filed under it — not that its tasks are done.

tools.name: gitpulse_get_task
tools.description: Read one task from the GitPulse task board with its canonical agent brief — the same Markdown GitPulse hands an agent it launches. Accepts the task_id it was added with, or an item_id from gitpulse_list_tasks.

tools.name: gitpulse_complete_task
tools.description: Move your GitPulse board task to done when the work is finished (or to review to hand it to a person, or in_progress when you start). Pass the task id from your brief's 'Task:' line, or the task_id it was filed with.

tools.name: gitpulse_delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task card from the GitPulse task board — the same delete as the board's own Delete. Pass the task_id it was filed with or its board item_id, and a reason: the reason is appended to the task's logs first, so it stays in the task's history.

tools.name: gitpulse_merge_tasks
tools.description: Merge duplicate or overlapping tasks on the GitPulse task board into one that stays.

tools.name: gitpulse_codeintel_search
tools.description: Search symbols across indexed code files via in-process devmap

tools.name: gitpulse_codeintel_impact
tools.description: Compute downstream blast radius / affected callers for a symbol or file

tools.name: gitpulse_codeintel_dependencies
tools.description: What a file depends on — the mirror of impact. Answers outgoing edges from the devmap code graph

tools.name: gitpulse_codeintel_trace
tools.description: Shortest edge path between two symbols in the devmap code graph

tools.name: gitpulse_codeintel_dead_symbols
tools.description: Unreferenced symbols in the indexed code graph. Unavailable is reported, never an empty list that reads as none found.

tools.name: gitpulse_codeintel_suspects
tools.description: Which commits since since could have caused a symptom. Blames only the lines belonging to symbols the symptom depends on, so the answer is the dependency cone rather than the file's recent history.

tools.name: gitpulse_provenance
tools.description: Read Git-native verification notes and confidence decay for a commit

tools.name: devcouncil_get_diff
tools.description: Return the working-tree (or staged) git diff, optionally scoped to a task's planned files or explicit paths.

tools.name: devcouncil_checkout_task
tools.description: Acquire a lease on a task and return its scope, lease token, and allowed next tools.

tools.name: devcouncil_renew_lease
tools.description: Extend an active lease before its TTL expires.

tools.name: devcouncil_release_task
tools.description: Release a held lease so another agent can check the task out.

tools.name: devcouncil_next_task
tools.description: Find the next ready, unheld task. Does not acquire a lease.

tools.name: devcouncil_verify_task
tools.description: Verify a leased task. Requires a valid lease_token.

tools.name: devcouncil_get_gaps
tools.description: Return verification gaps for a task from the latest persisted verification run.

tools.name: devcouncil_policy_check_write
tools.description: Ask whether a write to a path would be allowed under the current gate posture and optional task scope.

tools.name: devcouncil_next_task
tools.description: Find the next task that is ready to work and not already held by another agent. Call this first when you have no task; it does not claim anything.

tools.name: devcouncil_get_task
tools.description: Read a task's scope: planned files, allowed commands, expected tests, and prohibitions. Call this before writing anything, so you know what the task authorises.

tools.name: devcouncil_checkout_task
tools.description: Claim a task by taking its lease. One agent holds a task at a time.

tools.name: devcouncil_renew_lease
tools.description: Extend the current lease before it expires. Renewal only works before expiry; after that, check the task out again.

tools.name: devcouncil_release_task
tools.description: Release the current lease so another agent can take the task. Call this when you finish, or when you are abandoning the work.

tools.name: devcouncil_policy_check_write
tools.description: Ask whether a write would be allowed, without performing it. Call this when you are unsure whether a path is in scope — it is cheaper than a refused write.

tools.name: devcouncil_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the repository.

tools.name: devcouncil_write_file
tools.description: Write a file. The write passes the policy gate and requires a valid lease.

tools.name: devcouncil_patch_file
tools.description: Replace an exact target text substring with replacement text in a file. Avoids rewriting entire large files.

tools.name: devcouncil_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the repository. Passes the write policy gate (dc.OpDelete) and requires a valid task lease.

tools.name: devcouncil_exec_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command inside the repository. Requires an active task lease.

tools.name: devcouncil_list_dir
tools.description: List contents of a directory in the repository. Without recursive, reports the literal directory as it is on disk.

tools.name: devcouncil_find_files
tools.description: Find files in the repository matching a glob pattern (e.g. *.go, src/**/*.rs, *test*). Lists exactly the files devcouncil_grep would search: ignore rules apply by default, so .gitignore'd and hidden files are excluded unless include_ignored is set.

tools.name: devcouncil_grep
tools.description: Search for regular-expression matches across files in the repository. Ignore rules apply by default: .gitignore, .ignore, .git/info/exclude and hidden files are skipped, as are binary files.

tools.name: devcouncil_search_tools
tools.description: Search registered tools by capability or keyword without loading full schemas into context. Returns names, groups, descriptions, and active state.

tools.name: devcouncil_activate_tools
tools.description: Dynamically activate tools or entire tool groups into the model's active context. Prerequisites declared in requires are resolved and activated automatically.

tools.name: devcouncil_spawn_subagents
tools.description: Concurrently dispatch sub-agent tasks in bounded worker pool with lease tracking and cancellation cleanup. Give a task a type to run it as a defined role, on that role's model.

tools.name: devcouncil_request_override
tools.description: Ask for an exception to a soft policy block you just hit — for example a helper file the plan did not enumerate. Copy rule from the block's payload, put its target in path for a file block or in command for a command block, and state why in reason; it is recorded and reviewed.

tools.name: devcouncil_get_diff
tools.description: Show the working-tree changes for the current task, with the files each touches.

tools.name: devcouncil_verify_task
tools.description: Run the deterministic verifier over the working tree: are the changed files inside the task's declared scope? Returns passed, blocking gaps, and typed next actions.

tools.name: devcouncil_get_gaps
tools.description: List the verification gaps blocking the current task.

tools.name: devcouncil_get_next_actions
tools.description: Get the typed, machine-routable repair steps for the current task's gaps. Each carries a category you can branch on rather than prose to parse.

tools.name: devcouncil_graph_query
tools.description: Find symbols by name or path in the code graph, with the file and the source span of each hit.

tools.name: devcouncil_code_dead
tools.description: List symbols with no discovered callers. Each carries a confidence and, where one applies, the reason it is exempt — a symbol reached only through a build tag, a registry, or reflection looks callerless to any static analyser.

tools.name: devcouncil_graph_context
tools.description: For a set of files, what they depend on and what depends on them. Use before editing to see the blast radius.

tools.name: devcouncil_define_subagent
tools.description: Dynamically define or update a specialized subagent type with a custom role, system prompt, and tool configuration.

tools.name: devcouncil_invoke_subagent
tools.description: Invoke one or more subagents concurrently by name with custom task prompts, returning their unique conversation IDs and execution outcomes.

tools.name: devcouncil_send_message
tools.description: Send a message or instruction to an active subagent by its conversation ID.

tools.name: devcouncil_manage_subagents
tools.description: Manage subagents: list active direct subagents with live state, or terminate specific/all subagents.

tools.name: mcp_list_tools
tools.description: List available tools from configured Model Context Protocol (MCP 2.0) servers and Open Plugins.

tools.name: mcp_call_tool
tools.description: Call a tool on an external MCP 2.0 server or Open Plugin over stateless JSON-RPC.

tools.name: mcp_list_resources
tools.description: List resources exposed by a target MCP server.

tools.name: mcp_read_resource
tools.description: Read the contents of a resource from a target MCP server by URI.

tools.name: devcouncil_create_artifact
tools.description: Create a persistent structured artifact (e.g. implementation plan, walkthrough, research notes, architecture design document) under .devcouncil/artifacts/.

tools.name: devcouncil_update_artifact
tools.description: Update an existing structured artifact's content and metadata, incrementing its revision.

tools.name: devcouncil_list_artifacts
tools.description: List all persistent artifacts currently recorded in .devcouncil/artifacts/.

tools.name: devcouncil_ask_question
tools.description: Ask the user one or more interactive questions to clarify underspecified requirements, solicit design feedback, or pick a solution from options. Prioritize inquiry and clarify the impact of decisions before undertaking complex tasks or designing the UI for collaborative workflows.

tools.name: devcouncil_git_status
tools.description: Report the working tree's version-control state: current branch, HEAD commit, and which files are staged, modified, or untracked. Read-only; needs no lease.

tools.name: devcouncil_git_log
tools.description: List recent commits: hash, author, date, subject. Use this to orient before changing anything, not to reconstruct history.

tools.name: devcouncil_git_branches
tools.description: List local branches with the current one marked.

tools.name: devcouncil_git_show
tools.description: Show one commit's metadata and patch. Defaults to HEAD.

tools.name: devcouncil_git_stage
tools.description: Stage named paths for the next commit. Passes the command policy gate — the same ladder as devcouncil_exec_command — and refuses outright to stage credential and secret paths under any posture.

tools.name: devcouncil_git_commit
tools.description: Commit everything currently staged with the given message. Passes the command policy gate and refuses if the staged set contains a secret path, whatever staged it.

tools.name: devcouncil_dev_inspect
tools.description: Query a pinned DevCouncil inspect binary for project-level status/gaps/check JSON. The Python dev CLI is deleted; Go devcouncil does not implement those sections.

tools.name: devcouncil_fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a documentation page over https and return its text. Only hosts the operator allowlisted are reachable.

tools.name: wisdevSearchPapers
tools.description: Search academic papers across 15+ providers (OpenAlex, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Europe PMC, Crossref, DBLP, etc.). Returns ranked papers with titles, abstracts, authors, years, DOIs, and citation counts.

tools.name: wisdevPaperLookup
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a single paper by its provider-specific ID (e.g. arXiv ID like '2310.07862', DOI, or Semantic Scholar corpusId). Returns title, abstract, authors, year, venue, citation count, and open-access PDF URL.

tools.name: wisdevEvidenceSearch
tools.description: Retrieve candidate sources for a claim: searches for papers on the claim text and returns each candidate's most claim-relevant abstract sentence, ranked by lexical overlap with the claim.

tools.name: wisdevAuthorSearch
tools.description: Retrieve papers by a specific author using their provider-specific author ID. Returns a list of that author's papers with metadata.

tools.name: wisdevInspectPassages
tools.description: Inspect preserved citation passages owned by the authenticated user. Supply paperId and optionally chunkId for the exact cited window; dossierId/projectId narrow ownership.

tools.name: scholarlmPaperclipSearch
tools.description: Search the Paperclip biomedical corpus by FULL TEXT, not just titles and abstracts: PubMed Central, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, FDA regulatory documents, and ClinicalTrials.gov.

tools.name: scholarlmPaperclipGrep
tools.description: Regex search across Paperclip full text. Scope to the whole corpus or to one paper.

tools.name: scholarlmPaperclipRead
tools.description: Read a paper's full text, or one named section of it, from the Paperclip paper filesystem. Text is already segmented — no PDF download, no front matter.

tools.name: wisdevGenerateManuscript
tools.description: Start an async ScholarDoc manuscript job (literature-review style by default). Returns {jobId, status, pollHint} immediately — manuscripts are async; poll via scholarlmRunScript paper.status/watch.

tools.name: scholarlmSynthesizePaper
tools.description: Start an async ScholarDoc literature-synthesis job (same Full Paper pipeline as wisdevGenerateManuscript). Returns jobId; poll paper.status.

tools.name: scholarlmExportPaper
tools.description: Export a persisted ScholarDoc job (requires jobId) to markdown/html/latex via job-scoped export. Client content wraps are rejected.

tools.name: scholarlmExecuteWorkflow
tools.description: Start an async ScholarDoc job from a JSON flow (paper.run). Auto-approve defaults to false on SaaS.

tools.name: wisdevGetConfig
tools.description: Inspect the WisDev runtime's tunable configuration. Returns every tunable knob with its type, allowed range/enum, default, current value, and a description of what it controls.

tools.name: wisdevTuneConfig
tools.description: Tune the WisDev runtime. Pass a 'settings' object of knob-key → value to change runtime defaults that subsequent search/evidence/author/manuscript calls inherit.

tools.name: wisdevResetConfig
tools.description: Reset WisDev runtime knobs back to their built-in defaults. Pass 'keys' to reset a subset, or omit to reset everything.

tools.name: wisdevListProviders
tools.description: List the academic search providers registered in this runtime, with their canonical name, specialised domains, and current health. Use this to discover valid values for the 'sources' argument and the 'search.defaultSources' knob.

tools.name: wisdevCapabilities
tools.description: Describe everything this WisDev MCP runtime can do: the callable tools, the tunable configuration groups, and the introspectable resources. Use this for a one-shot overview of the full control surface.

tools.name: scholarlmSignIn
tools.description: Explain ScholarLM MCP authentication. Authenticate with an Authorization bearer token at the deployed MCP endpoint; do not pass credentials in a tool argument.

tools.name: scholarlmGetAuthStatus
tools.description: Inspect MCP auth status: userID, subscription tier, VIP, admin, and whether ScholarDoc generate is allowed. Entitlements come from gateway-injected headers on HTTP MCP (Firebase Bearer).

tools.name: scholarlmListScripts
tools.description: List allowlisted ScholarLM script capabilities with execution_target (remote|local_only). Remote ops never use os/exec.

tools.name: scholarlmRunScript
tools.description: Execute allowlisted remote capabilities (search, paper.*). Local-only ops (stack.*, agent) rejected with guidance.

tools.name: scholarlmListSkills
tools.description: List the available ScholarLM MCP workflow and repository engineering skills. Returns names accepted by scholarlmGetSkillInstructions.

tools.name: scholarlmGetSkillInstructions
tools.description: Read full instruction markdown (SKILL.md) for a skill returned by scholarlmListSkills: ScholarLM MCP workflows or repository engineering guidance.

tools.name: scholarlmGetAppDocs
tools.description: Retrieve an embedded developer reference excerpt. docName is one of workflows, agents, architecture, mcp_guide, or dev_reference (MCP-facing excerpt — not a raw repo filename).

tools.name: scholarlmGetSystemStatus
tools.description: Report MCP server identity, supported protocol versions, registered search provider count, and whether ScholarDoc lifecycle is wired. Does not probe ports, ADK, or LLM health.

tools.name: engine_status
tools.description: Health, current iteration, and per-section scores/word-counts.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List the review sections with their evidence-packet keys.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Read one section's current draft and open findings.

tools.name: set_section_goal
tools.description: Reshape a section's writing goal/intent before (re)generating it.

tools.name: set_genre
tools.description: Set the manuscript genre (drives the aligned critic's referee rubric and review voice).

tools.name: load_spec
tools.description: Retarget the engine at a DIFFERENT manuscript by loading another JSON spec/config file.

tools.name: spec_template
tools.description: Get the spec schema + example so an LLM can convert a free-form user brief into a runnable spec.

tools.name: set_spec
tools.description: Drive the engine from a spec synthesized inline (e.g. an LLM turning a user's brief/flow into a manuscript), no file needed.

tools.name: reset_state
tools.description: Clear persisted engine state and rebuild from the current spec for a clean run.

tools.name: generate_all
tools.description: Have ScholarLM draft every section from its evidence packets.

tools.name: generate_section
tools.description: Have ScholarLM (re)draft a single section.

tools.name: review_manuscript
tools.description: Run ScholarLM review + the engine's fused critics; returns score and per-section findings.

tools.name: fact_check_section
tools.description: Run the server's prose-vs-source entailment fact-check on a section; returns flagged unsupported sentences as findings.

tools.name: coordinate_dedupe
tools.description: Run the whole-manuscript redundancy-resolution pass (keeps each repeated point in one owning section).

tools.name: inject_guidance
tools.description: STEER: push targeted findings for a section to apply on its next revision.

tools.name: revise_section
tools.description: Revise a section using injected guidance + heuristic findings (or explicit findings).

tools.name: run_iteration
tools.description: Run one or more full generate-review-revise improvement cycles.

tools.name: generate_abstract
tools.description: Write the abstract from a set of citation keys.

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Convergence diagnostics: scores, calls, per-section revisions.

tools.name: export_draft
tools.description: Export the assembly-ready sections JSON for the LaTeX builder.

tools.name: save_state
tools.description: Persist engine state for a later resume.

tools.name: career_search_kb
tools.description: Search the career knowledgebase across blocks, bullets, facts and KB chunks. Runs semantic vector search when an embedding provider is reachable and always runs a word-boundary lexical pass, merging both.

tools.name: career_get_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the candidate's complete master career profile including all experience blocks (work, education, projects, skills), distilled facts, and personas.

tools.name: career_upsert_block
tools.description: Create or update an experience block (work, project, education, skill_group, leadership) in the candidate's career database. This is a whole-document replace: any bullet or fact absent from the payload is discarded.

tools.name: career_delete_block
tools.description: Delete an experience block and its associated embeddings. Requires MRTR confirmation when the block has bullets or facts; the returned request_state binds the confirmation to that specific block, and a follow-up naming a different block_id is rejected.

tools.name: career_distill_facts
tools.description: Distill unstructured notes, project summaries, or accomplishment write-ups into structured atomic facts with extracted skills and metrics.

tools.name: career_add_facts
tools.description: Append verified atomic facts to an existing experience block in the career database.

tools.name: career_list_personas
tools.description: List all career personas (AI/ML, Life Sciences, Management, Custom) with their default templates, skill weights, and tone directives.

tools.name: career_upsert_persona
tools.description: Create or update a career persona with tailored section orders and tone directives.

tools.name: career_ingest_knowledge
tools.description: Ingest a document, text notes, or resume into the career knowledgebase chunk store for semantic retrieval.

tools.name: resume_analyze_jd
tools.description: Extract a canonical JDProfile from a job description: roleTitle, seniority, mustHaveSkills, niceToHaveSkills, domains, atsKeywords, toneSignals, and the responsibilities/qualifications section text.

tools.name: resume_gap_analysis
tools.description: Classify every JD must-have as covered / weak / missing by searching block skill tags, domains, bullet text AND the fact pool with word-boundary matching. Returns per-skill evidence hits, counts, and a coverage percentage computed over the blocks that would actually be printed.

tools.name: resume_score_and_select
tools.description: Score every experience block (skills / persona / recency / seniority, renormalised because no embedding provider is bound) and pack them into a page budget with a wrap-aware greedy knapsack: per-section caps, per-org de-duplication, and a must-have coverage repair pass.

tools.name: resume_rewrite_bullets
tools.description: Verify bullet drafts against canonical provenance. This server does NOT generate rewrites: supply your own drafts in drafts and every canonical metric on the source bullet is checked against your text, with drops reported and the canonical text substituted on failure.

tools.name: resume_synthesize
tools.description: Run the deterministic synthesis stages: JD scan, block scoring, knapsack selection, must-have gap analysis, real ATS keyword coverage, and (unless render=false) materialization through an injection-safe plain Typst layout.

tools.name: resume_compile
tools.description: Compile Typst resume source to PDF with the in-process, filesystem-denied Typst engine, returning diagnostics; pdfBase64 only when include_pdf=true (default false — PDF bytes flood agent context; pdfOmitted reports a suppressed PDF honestly).

tools.name: resume_finetune_bullet
tools.description: Analyse a bullet against a JD and report findings: weak opening verb, presence of a quantity, which supplied verified metrics are actually expressed in the text, JD keywords present/absent, and estimated rendered lines.

tools.name: resume_ats_check
tools.description: Simulate how an applicant tracking system parses resume text: which sections it detects (summary/experience/education/skills/projects/publications/leadership/certifications/awards/languages/volunteer/links/contact), whether the system's required sections are present.

tools.name: resume_doc_list_projects
tools.description: List workspace projects registered with DevPrism — the only roots these document tools may touch. Read-only.

tools.name: resume_doc_list_files
tools.description: List source files of a registered project (relative paths + sizes). Dot-directories like .prism/.git are excluded; use resume_variant_list for tailored versions.

tools.name: resume_doc_read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from a registered project. Returns content plus its sha1 — pass that sha1 as expected_sha1 to later writes/edits so concurrent changes cannot be clobbered.

tools.name: resume_doc_write
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file (.typ .tex .md .txt .json .yaml .yml .bib .cls .sty .csv) in a registered project.

tools.name: resume_doc_edit
tools.description: Apply several exact-string edits to ONE file atomically (all-or-nothing: every edit must match or nothing is written). Requires expected_sha1 from a prior read; backs up the original.

tools.name: resume_variant_list
tools.description: List tailored versions (variants) of a registered master project. Accepts a master or variant path.

tools.name: resume_variant_create
tools.description: Snapshot the master's sources into <project>/.prism/variants/<slug>/ as a new tailored version. Additive; never touches the master.

tools.name: resume_variant_update
tools.description: Update a variant's display name, pipeline status, or job description. Does not touch document sources.

tools.name: resume_variant_delete
tools.description: Delete a tailored version folder permanently. Requires human confirmation via MRTR: call without request_state to receive an inputRequired confirmation, have the user approve, then re-call passing request_state and input_responses.confirm=true.

tools.name: resume_variant_diff
tools.description: Diff a variant against its master file by file (added/modified/deleted, with contents). Read-only.

tools.name: resume_compile_file
tools.description: Compile a Typst resume from a registered project with the in-process engine. Defaults to the detected main .typ source.

tools.name: resume_save_synthesis
tools.description: Persist generated Typst resume source as a NEW tailored version of a registered master: creates the variant snapshot, replaces the variant's main Typst file with the given source, compiles a verification PDF into the variant's .prism/build/, and records the JD text.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Fetch the agent's task card (title, description, subtasks, current status) and the board's column layout. Call this first to orient yourself.

tools.name: update_status
tools.description: Move the agent's task card to a board column by id or title. Board lifecycle: Task → In Progress → Completed → Commit.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Signal that your work on this task is DONE. Verified before acceptance: your card must be In Progress, and if you work in an isolated worktree it must contain actual changes (dirty files or commits) unless you pass no_changes: true.

tools.name: get_worktree_state
tools.description: Inspect your isolated git worktree: branch name, count of uncommitted (dirty) files, commits ahead of the main checkout, and last commit. Call before complete_task to confirm your work is actually captured.

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: Add a progress note to the task's activity trail. Post one when you start a major step, hit something surprising, or finish a milestone — this is how the user follows your progress on the board.

tools.name: create_subtask
tools.description: Create an open subtask under the agent's current task.

tools.name: toggle_subtask
tools.description: Check off (or reopen) a subtask on the current task by title or id.

tools.name: report_blocker
tools.description: File a blocker as a new task linked to the current work.

tools.name: get_user_guidance
